title: Clinic question bank, own 4GE1-style
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y11 lesson 46 (Clinic question bank and mark schemes, own exam-style (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 46. One short question from each section. Choose the one that matches your weakest skill, then self-mark.

questions.a: The time between peak rainfall and peak discharge

questions.q: Explain how urbanisation increases flood risk.
questions.a: Impermeable surfaces (1) reduce infiltration (1), so more, faster surface run-off reaches the river, shortening lag time (1)

questions.q: Describe how longshore drift moves sediment.
questions.a: Swash moves sediment up the beach at an angle with the prevailing wind (1); backwash pulls it straight back (1); in a zigzag along the coast (1)
They trap sediment (1), starving beaches further along, which then erode faster (terminal groyne effect) (1)

questions.q: Explain why the effects of earthquakes are often worse in developing countries.
questions.a: Buildings less earthquake-resistant (1); fewer resources for rescue and hospitals (1); dense, informal housing near the epicentre (1)

questions.q: Explain one way to improve the reliability of a river enquiry.
questions.a: Take readings at more sites (1) so one unusual site has less effect on the pattern (1)

questions.q: Suggest one hypothesis for a human enquiry.
questions.a: For example: environmental quality improves with distance from the town centre

questions.q: Explain one reason for the growth of informal settlements in a megacity.
questions.a: Rapid rural-urban migration (1) faster than affordable housing can be built (1), so people build homes on unused land (1)

questions.q: Assess the effectiveness of one strategy to manage energy supply.
questions.a: Indicative: named strategy (for example renewables in the UK); successes with evidence; limits (cost, intermittency); judgement (levels: 1 to 3 limited, 4 to 6 developed, 7 to 8 evaluative)
